Laurey 89201, 1-1/4 Thistle Cabinet Knob in Satin Stainless Steel

The Stainless Steel Thistle Cabinet Knob is a common choice for modern kitchens. The contemporary design is both interesting and sleek. The 1-1/4 Thistle Cabinet Knob in Satin Stainless Steel comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Satin Stainless Thistle Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
